messages:
sasha: FYI last night's nightly-evals showed a big spike in summarization timeouts for rwd-pegasus-int8. Scores dropped ~20% and many prompts were empty in the debug CSV :eyes:

morgan: ugh, saw a few of those. quick grep of the worker logs shows prompts becoming an empty string after normalization on some runs

kevin: can you paste the log snippet?

sasha: here — note the CR at end of original prompt and then an empty 'after' prompt:

```
[2026-03-19T03:12:10Z] prompt_id=137 before_norm="Summarize: Explain X.\r"\n[2026-03-19T03:12:10Z] prompt_id=137 after_norm=""
[2026-03-19T03:12:10Z] worker=3 model_backend=quantized int8 padding=legacy
```

morgan: reproducer I ran locally: `EVAL_WORKERS=4 python -m eval_harness.run --model rwd-pegasus --variant=int8 --batch 1 --seed 2026` — failure only when batch=1 and worker>1

kevin: interesting, non-quantized float32 run on same machine passed. so it's not the prompt set itself

tal: could be normalization + padding interaction. our old `normalize_prompt` does `return p.strip()` which removes `\r` and other whitespace — but downstream quantized padding code treats an empty string differently and returns an empty token sequence

morgan: exact snippet from harness: 
```
def normalize_prompt(p):
    return p.strip()
```

morgan: proposed quick fix: be explicit about CR handling and guard empty after normalize:
```
def normalize_prompt(p):
    # preserve spaces, remove only CR, then rstrip single LF
    p = p.replace('\r', '')
    p = p.rstrip('\n')
    return p if p else '\n'
```

kevin: adding a sentinel newline for empty prompts seems fine as a safety-net. we should also add a unit test covering a prompt that ends with `\r` and ensure tokenization doesn't return empty sequence

sasha: also found this in the quantized backend logs — it expects at least one padding token, otherwise sampling hangs and times out: 
```
ERROR model_runner QuantizedRunner: got zero-length token buffer, aborting sample
```

tal: timeline: I'll add the unit test + small patch to normalize behavior today. If tests pass, push to canary nightly and re-run 2026-03-20 02:00 job.

kevin: ping ci-bot for a forced nightly re-run after deploy? @eval-bot can you schedule the run once patch is merged? :pray:

eval-bot: scheduled nightly job `eval-nightly` for 2026-03-20T02:05Z (triggered by request). Job id: eval-20260320-02-05-7b2

morgan: creating PR with the sanitize + test now -> will link once ready

sasha: thanks — marking this as P1 for the eval harness flaky failures triage board. will follow up if CI still shows regressions. :thumbsup:
